segments.speaker: me
segments.text: Morning everyone. Let's get going, we have thirty minutes and three things: the beta date, the onboarding emails, and the pricing page.

segments.speaker: others
segments.text: Morning. Priya here. Quick status first, the build is green and QA signed off on the core flows yesterday afternoon.

segments.speaker: others
segments.text: This is Marcus. Same on my side, the analytics events are all wired up, so we'll actually see where people drop off this time.

segments.speaker: me
segments.text: Great. So the beta date. I was thinking we ship next Tuesday.

segments.speaker: others
segments.text: Tuesday is tight for me. The release notes and the help center articles won't be done until Wednesday night.

segments.speaker: others
segments.text: Marcus again. Also Tuesday is the day the sales team has their offsite, so nobody would be around to answer customer questions.

segments.speaker: me
segments.text: Okay, that settles it. Let's ship on Thursday instead. Thursday morning, Pacific time.

segments.speaker: others
segments.text: Thursday works. I'll have the release notes and help articles done by Wednesday end of day.

segments.speaker: me
segments.text: Perfect. How many people are in the beta list right now?

segments.speaker: others
segments.text: We have forty, sorry, forty-five companies signed up, and about three hundred individual users across them.

segments.speaker: me
segments.text: Nice, that's more than I expected. Next, onboarding emails. Marcus, where are we?

segments.speaker: others
segments.text: I drafted the three-email sequence. Welcome, a day-three tips email, and a day-seven feedback survey. I want to cut the day-three one, honestly, it's just noise.

segments.speaker: me
segments.text: I'd keep it, but make it shorter. Tips are where people find the import feature, and that's our best predictor of retention.

segments.speaker: others
segments.text: Fair. Okay, I'll keep it and cut it down to three tips. I'll send the drafts to you by Monday.

segments.speaker: others
segments.text: Priya. Who's sending the survey results to the design team? Last beta that fell through the cracks.

segments.speaker: me
segments.text: I'll own that. I'll share a summary with design every Friday during the beta.

segments.speaker: me
segments.text: Last thing, the pricing page. Do we show prices during the beta or not?

segments.speaker: others
segments.text: Marcus. I'd say no prices yet. We haven't decided between per-seat and usage-based, and showing a number we change later burns trust.

segments.speaker: others
segments.text: Priya. Agreed, but we need some answer when people ask. Can we say free during the beta and pricing announced at launch?

segments.speaker: me
segments.text: Yes, let's do that. Free during the beta, pricing announced at launch. Marcus, can you update the page copy?

segments.speaker: others
segments.text: Sure, I'll update it by Wednesday so it goes out with the beta.

segments.speaker: others
segments.text: One open question from me. Do we need legal to review the beta terms again since we changed the data retention policy?

segments.speaker: me
segments.text: Good question, I honestly don't know. Let's not block on it today. I'll ask legal and we'll decide on Monday.

segments.speaker: others
segments.text: Also, are we doing a launch post on the blog, or waiting for general availability?

segments.speaker: me
segments.text: Let's park that. It depends on how the first week goes.

segments.speaker: me
segments.text: Okay, recap. Beta ships Thursday morning. Priya does release notes and help articles by Wednesday. Marcus does the shorter email sequence by Monday and the pricing copy by Wednesday. I'll talk to legal and send design the weekly survey summary. Thanks everyone.

segments.speaker: others
segments.text: Thanks, bye.

decisions: Beta ships Thursday morning Pacific (moved from Tuesday)
Keep the day-three tips email but shorten it to three tips
Pricing page says free during the beta, pricing announced at launch
action_items: Priya: release notes + help center articles by Wednesday end of day
Marcus: onboarding email drafts (shortened) to You by Monday
Marcus: update pricing page copy by Wednesday
You: weekly Friday survey summary to design
You: ask legal about beta terms; decide Monday
open_questions: Does legal need to re-review beta terms after the data retention change?
Blog launch post now or at GA? (parked)
facts: Tuesday rejected: docs not ready and sales offsite
